specification.title: Tether Health production mobile UI specification
specification.status: implementation-ready design contract; clinical and legal content approval required before release
specification.purpose: Single source of truth for rendering, simulating, validating, and implementing the complete Tether Health mobile application.
specification.sampleDataPolicy: All preview values are visibly generic development fixtures, never user records.

rules: Warm ivory is the default canvas.
Deep evergreen is the primary action and headline color.
Coral is reserved for urgent help and compassionate interruption.
Citrus lime marks active timers and positive focus, never danger.
Mint groups supportive information.
Cards use 20dp radius and restrained elevation.
Do not use blue or purple.
Use one dominant primary button per viewport.

componentContract.renderingRule: Map layout.sections in order to native Flutter widgets. Unknown component types fail closed with a visible development error.
componentContract.actionRule: Render screen.actions in the sticky safe-area action bar unless a component explicitly owns the action.
componentContract.dataRule: Resolve only named state bindings; never evaluate executable code from JSON.
componentContract.contentRule: Localize every visible string; preserve the safety meaning during translation.

appShell.programIsolation: Each program owns separate state, consent, sharing, reminders, export scope and deletion controls.

transitionGuards: Authentication is required after program selection.
Required consent is required before program activation.
Program switching never copies health answers.
External call or text actions require explicit platform confirmation.

packages.storage: encrypted SQLite strategy reviewed per platform

generationSteps: Parse this file into immutable Dart models.
Validate component type and required properties before rendering.
Register routes from sharedScreens and programs[].screens.
Map component types to native widgets.
Run semantics tests at 200% text scale.
Run transition tests for every action destination.
Replace generic preview fixtures with approved test fixtures only.
securityRequirements: Never interpolate user data into route paths or query strings.
Encrypt local health data and backups according to the reviewed platform threat model.
Use OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE, state and nonce for Apple and Google.
Store session secrets only in platform secure storage.
Redact health details from notifications, crash reports and analytics.
Authorize every record by user and program scope on the server.

design: All 706 screens render at both reference sizes without overflow.
All buttons have visible destinations and state effects.
All 11 programs preserve the same visual grammar while using condition-specific content.
accessibility: VoiceOver and TalkBack order matches visual order.
No clipped content at 200% text scale.
Contrast and focus indicators meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
Reduced-motion mode has no essential motion.
safety: SteadyMind crisis bar appears on all 66 screens.
Heartwise emergency card appears on all 66 screens.
ClearAir action-plan zones appear on all 66 screens.
Nourish Home contains no weight value.
Present requests no social account connection and keeps social sharing off.
Tobacco language appears only in BreatheFree program screens.
All urgent external actions require explicit confirmation and use approved jurisdiction configuration.
engineering: Every route is unique and reachable.
Every save action handles pending sync, retry and conflict.
No prohibited analytics property is emitted.
